title: Can AI be decoupled from human will?
header_line: Jose's analysis of a book we are still naming. Not a summary of the book. Not affiliated with or endorsed by the author or publisher.

lines.text: If a machine could do your thinking better than you, would you hand it over?

Jose said this chapter is very dense, and a pivotal point. There are two schools of thought. One of the two men says: why does it matter if machines surpass human intelligence, even consciousness? It is the next stage of evolution.

The other says that human consciousness is a precious flicker of light in the universe that should never be extinguished. They were friends and now they are not, because of this philosophical conflict.

Jose asked a student: where would you be in that? The student said they don't think AI should take over human consciousness. There is a good balance, but it is scary, and a little scary that it is out of our control.

groups.heading: Can AI be decoupled from human will?

lines.text: A student said that humans are, mathematically, rather detrimental to their own existence over a long enough time, so a strong enough AI could deduce that a mass population reduction is the best outcome for humanity to survive. They said this idea is used in movies.

Jose said the question he took from this chapter is: can artificial intelligence be decoupled from human will? That is at the heart of the conflict between the two men. Is there a danger in decoupling artificial intelligence from human will?
A student said: if you take the power cord off the computer, you can't unplug it suddenly when it has a bug.

Jose said one human mind is no match for a chatbot in the amount of data it can draw on. Can some robot with that capability overtake the intelligence of a human mind to make a decision? That is what we are talking about.

A student said that free will is already being interfered with. Social media is programming our dopamine centres and we are becoming dependent and addicted. Right now that is human-controlled, but as AI gets more intelligent it could be a different thing.
If it controlled the sources where we get all our information, the student said, and our messages and emails, that is profound control and influence over people.

Another student said it is already used more than a search engine as a source of information, so it is almost a mass information filter. Take the most important information, manipulate it by one degree, and nobody ends up at true north.
Where do you stand on handing decisions to a machine?

exercise.title: Five minutes
steps: Write which decisions you would never hand to a machine.
Write how you check where your information comes from.
Write what the power cord is in your own use of technology.
Write your position: next stage of evolution, or a flicker of light to protect.

check.q: What question did Jose take from this chapter?
choices: Can artificial intelligence be decoupled from human will?

check.q: What did a student say is already happening with social media?
choices: It programs our dopamine centres and makes us dependent

check.q: What did one view say about machines surpassing humans?
choices: It is the next stage of evolution

recap: Know where you stand on handing decisions to machines. Check your information.
